location.site_description: QTS Fort Worth 1 campus near AllianceTexas in north Fort Worth; QTS lists FTW1 DC1 at 14100 Park Vista Boulevard and FTW1 DC2 at 14052 Park Vista Boulevard, while several government filings use 14100 Park Vista Boulevard for the campus / DC2 records.

actions.government_body: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation
actions.summary: TDLR registered QTS FTW1 DC2 as a privately funded new two-story, 42 MW data center addition to the existing campus, 471,876 square feet, $220 million estimated cost, start 2024-03-01 and completion 2026-04-01; current status is Inspection Complete.

actions.government_body: City of Fort Worth Development Services Department
actions.summary: Fort Worth's CY 2024 Development Activity Report lists QTS FTW1 DC2 at 14052 Park Vista Blvd as new commercial construction of a new data center, 471,876 square feet, $160,201,754 valuation, in June 2024.

actions.government_body: City of Fort Worth Development Services Department
actions.summary: The same Fort Worth CY 2024 Development Activity Report lists QTS FTW1-DC2 Ph 2 at 14052 Park Vista Blvd as a commercial remodel of interior data center space, 99,400 square feet, $52 million valuation, in December 2024.

City Secretary contract materials for QTS Investment Properties Fort Worth, LLC identify the QTS Data Center at 14100 Park Vista Boulevard and include water, sewer, storm, and easement encroachment exhibits updated in 2024.

actions.government_body: City of Fort Worth Transportation and Public Works
actions.summary: Fort Worth TPW accepted QTS Fort Worth water, sewer, and paving improvements after final inspection on 2025-12-05 and punch-list completion on 2025-12-16; the document names QTS Data Centers as developer.

actions.government_body: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation
actions.summary: TDLR registered a QTS FTW1 DC1 additions-to-existing-building expansion at 14100 Park Vista Blvd, 168,770 square feet, $130 million estimated cost, with start 2025-07-01 and completion 2026-10-01.

actions.government_body: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation
actions.summary: TDLR registered another QTS FTW1 DC1 Expansion as new construction of a two-story, 147,946-square-foot data center with equipment yard at 14100 Park Vista Blvd, $300 million estimated cost, start 2026-07-01 and completion 2027-10-01.

QTS's Fort Worth 1 campus page lists a 52-acre campus, 70 MW+ critical campus capacity, 200 MW gross campus planned potential, an on-site substation with expansion capability, and locations for FTW1 DC1 and FTW1 DC2.

capacity_mw.evidence_note: QTS publishes 70 MW+ critical campus capacity and 200 MW gross planned potential for the campus. TDLR separately identifies the DC2 new-construction project as a 42 MW data center addition. No utility energization or interconnection completion record was located in this refresh.

owner: QTS / Quality Technology Services; TDLR DC2 owner entity is QTS Fort Worth I DC2 LLC, while later DC1 expansion filings list Quality Technology Services, LLC or Quality Technology Services (QTS).

sources.match_reason: Seed-only QTS Fort Worth record matched to official TDLR, City of Fort Worth, and QTS campus records for FTW1 / QTS Fort Worth 1.

contradictions.issue: DC2 address differs across official/company sources: TDLR's DC2 record uses 14100 PARK VISTA BLVD, while QTS's campus page and Fort Worth's CY 2024 Development Activity Report list FTW1 DC2 / QTS FTW1 DC2 at 14052 Park Vista Boulevard.
contradictions.resolution: Track both addresses at campus level; use 14100 Park Vista Boulevard for legacy/DC1/government campus references and 14052 Park Vista Boulevard for QTS-listed FTW1 DC2.

contradictions.issue: Owner/developer entity naming varies across official records: DC2 TDLR lists QTS Fort Worth I DC2 LLC, 2025 TDLR expansion lists Quality Technology Services, LLC, 2026 TDLR expansion lists Quality Technology Services (QTS), and City public-works acceptance references QTS Data Centers as developer.
contradictions.resolution: Use QTS / Quality Technology Services as the operating owner family and preserve filing-specific entities in actions.

contradictions.issue: TDLR shows DC2 accessibility inspection complete and QTS markets the Fort Worth 1 campus as having active capacity, but no certificate of occupancy, energization, or utility-service record was found for DC2 or the newer DC1 expansions.
contradictions.resolution: Use partial live for the campus because QTS lists current critical campus capacity; keep DC1/DC2 expansion actions below energized/full-buildout until utility or CO evidence is located.

history.note: Baseline seed-only record had no independently verified status, capacity, owner, or street address.
